heroes.name: Roadhog
heroes.summary: The addition of Trash Compactor and a reworked Scrap Gun shifts Roadhog toward a more active, projectile-absorbing tank role with higher primary fire consistency.

changes.note: Ammo reloaded increased from 2 to 4.
Removed.
New Minor Perk.
During Whole Hog, Chain Hook’s cooldown is reduced by 80%.
Removed.
New Major Perk.
Enemies in front of Roadhog while Trash Compactor is active are slowed by 30% and take 20 damage per second.
Primary Fire now fires 2 bursts per volley.
Ammo increased from 6 to 12.
Total damage per volley increased from 175 to 204.
Critical damage multiplier decreased from 2x to 1.5x.
Shotgun pellet count decreased from 25 to 16.
Shotgun pellet damage decreased from 7 to 4.25.
Now fires a larger projectile in the center of each shot.
Center projectile deals 34 damage.
Spread decreased from 8 degrees to 6 degrees.
Falloff range decreased from 30-50 meters to 20-35 meters.
Projectile speed increased from 80 meters per second to 100 meters per second.
Removed.
New ability assigned to Secondary Fire by default.
When activated, begin absorbing projectiles in front of Roadhog for 2 seconds.
After the duration, fire an explosive projectile whose damage scales based on the damage absorbed, ranging from 75 to 200 damage.
Explosion inner radius of 2 meters, explosion outer radius of 6 meters with a 30% falloff scalar.
Impact damage is 10.
Conversion rate is 30% of damage absorbed.
Movement speed penalty of 15% while active.
Cooldown is 10 seconds in 5v5.
Cooldown is 11 seconds in 6v6.
Enemy stun duration after being pulled decreased from 0.4 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
Target’s final distance from Roadhog after being pulled increased from 3 meters to 4.5 meters.
Cooldown decreased from 7 seconds to 6 seconds in 5v5.
Cooldown decreased from 8 seconds to 7 seconds in 6v6.
Max duration decreased from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.
Healing over time increased from 150 per second to 200 per second.
Damage reduction decreased from 40% to 35%.
Cooldown increased from 1.25 seconds to 2 seconds.

heroes.name: Sombra
heroes.summary: Moving to the Support role, Sombra now focuses on utility-based healing and area weakening while retaining stealth and information-gathering capabilities.

changes.note: Moved from Damage to Support role.
Moved from Recon subrole to Tactician subrole.
Experience required to earn minor perk increased by 67%.
Experience required to earn major perk increased by 69.5%.
Removed.
New Minor Perk.
EMP applies Hotfix to all nearby allies.
Removed.
New Major Perk.
Hacking health packs with Hotfix reduces its main cooldown by 4 seconds.
Removed.
New Major Perk.
Cyberspace’s healing is doubled on allies below half health.
Damage per projectile decreased from 8 to 7.
Minimum falloff distance increased from 15 meters to 20 meters.
Maximum spread decreased from 2.3 degrees to 2 degrees.
Shots until max spread increased from 6 to 10.
Ultimate cost increased by 67.5%.
Damage decreased from 25% of current health to 20% of current health.
Removed.
New ability assigned to Secondary Fire by default.
Heal an ally over time for a set amount of health.
Hotfixing an ally heals them for 65 instant health and 25 health per second over its duration.
Hotfix lasts on an ally until either 175 total healing is done or until 12 seconds have passed.
Hotfix can also target health packs and most enemy deployables to hack them, which does not require any Hotfix charges and triggers a separate 6 second cooldown.
Hacked health pack duration decreased from 45 seconds to 30 seconds.
Hacking health packs or deployables can be interrupted by taking damage, which will cancel the ability and trigger the separate 6 second cooldown.
Hotfix can be used while stealthed, temporarily revealing Sombra without breaking stealth.
Cast time is 0.5 seconds.
Range is 17 meters.
Has 2 charges.
Cooldown is 8 seconds.
Removed.
New ability assigned to Ability 1 by default.
Launch a projectile that explodes on impact, creating a zone that weakens enemies and heals allies.
Initial explosion deals 40 damage to enemies and 40 healing to allies.
Zone deals 25 damage per second to enemies and 30 healing per second to allies.
Zone duration is 3 seconds.
Zone radius is 5 meters.
Enemies within the zone are weakened, which is a new status effect that reduces the target’s own damage and healing output by 50%.
Stealth duration increased from 5 seconds to 6.5 seconds.
Time to enter Stealth increased from 0.3 seconds to 0.75 seconds.
Projectile range reduced from 18 meters to 12.25 meters.
Movement speed bonus is now active immediately after teleporting instead of after fully entering Stealth.
Cooldown increased from 6 seconds to 7.5 seconds.
Removed.
New Passive.
Fully-charged enemy ultimates are revealed to you.
Head hit volume increased from 14 to 16.
Torso hit volume reduced from 25 to 23.
Leg hit volumes increased from 15 to 18.

heroes.name: D.Va
heroes.summary: Increased fire rate on Micro Missiles significantly boosts D.Va's burst damage potential during dives.

changes.note: Fire rate increased from 11 to 14 shots per second.

heroes.name: Domina
heroes.summary: Enhanced ability lifesteal and a shorter Crystal Charge cooldown provide Domina with much higher combat sustain and mobility.

changes.note: Cooldown reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.
Ability lifesteal increased from 75% to 100%.

Head hit volume increased from 20 to 21.5.

Lower arm hit volume reduced from 20 to 15.

Leg hit volumes reduced from 24 to 22.

heroes.name: Genji

Damage reduced from 110 to 100.

heroes.name: Shion

changes.note: Removed.
New.

heroes.name: Ana

changes.note: Removed.
New.
Sleep dart explodes on impact, slowing enemies and dealing 45 damage over 3 seconds.

heroes.name: Doctrine

Cooldown increased from 7 to 8 seconds.

No longer provides critical hit immunity while active.
Drone Fire Rate increased from 4 to 5.
Overhealth and debuff duration reduced from 8 to 6 seconds.
Decay duration reduced from 5 to 4 seconds.

heroes.name: Lúcio
